headline.en: Review a smaller plan before accepting the work.
headline.zh: 接受任务前先检查更小的计划。

sub.en: ScopeReflex derives a contracted variant of a JSON or Markdown plan and presents the structural difference for review.
sub.zh: ScopeReflex 从 JSON 或 Markdown 计划生成缩减版本，并展示结构差异供检查。

body.en: The original and contracted manifests are both retained.
body.zh: 同时保留原始和缩减 manifest。

body.en: Rules record the rationale for contraction.
The gate separates review from accepted-plan output.
body.zh: gate 将检查与已接受计划输出分开。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Apply contract --summary to the complete bundled plan without writing an accepted plan.
note.zh: 对完整随仓计划执行 contract --summary，不写入已接受计划。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Deterministic contraction of the complete bundled plan. Counts are structural and token values are heuristic estimates; no source code is edited or plan accepted.

body.en: Apply contract --summary to the complete bundled plan without writing an accepted plan.
body.zh: 对完整随仓计划执行 contract --summary，不写入已接受计划。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/scopereflex.git
cd scopereflex
npm ci
npm run build

limitations.en: Rules do not inspect the implementation or prove that the smaller plan satisfies the task. Review removed work before accepting it.
limitations.zh: 规则不检查实现，也不证明更小计划满足任务；接受前应检查删除内容。

limitations.en: Token values are heuristics based on file/step counts and different coefficients, not measured output savings.
limitations.zh: token 值基于文件/步骤数量和不同系数估计，不是实测输出节省。

limitations.en: The demo only reports a contraction. It does not accept a plan or modify source code.
limitations.zh: 示例只报告缩减，不接受计划或修改源码。

body.en: Optional steps and duplicate file entries can make a proposed plan harder to assess. A rule-generated alternative lets you inspect what would be dropped or merged before accepting it.
body.zh: 可选步骤与重复文件条目可能让提案更难评估。规则生成的替代方案让你在接受前检查哪些内容被删除或合并。

body.en: The parser validates the plan. Ordered rules deduplicate files, merge helper descriptions into sibling indexes, drop optional files and steps, and estimate a shorter output. contract reports the diff; gate can write a contracted plan after a selection.
body.zh: 解析器校验计划；有序规则去重文件，把 helper 描述合并到同目录 index，删除可选文件和步骤，再估计较短输出。contract 报告差异，gate 可在选择后写出缩减计划。

body.en: The parser validates the plan. Ordered rules deduplicate files, merge helper descriptions into sibling indexes, drop optional files and steps, and estimate a shorter output. contract reports the diff; gate can write a contracted plan after a selection.
body.zh: 解析器校验计划；有序规则去重文件，把 helper 描述合并到同目录 index，删除可选文件和步骤，再估计较短输出。contract 报告差异，gate 可在选择后写出缩减计划。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: Mark optional files and steps explicitly in the input. output_length_tokens can supply the original estimate; otherwise the tool estimates it. contract is read-only. gate writes a separate contracted plan on acceptance; --accept bypasses the interactive review.
body.zh: 在输入中显式标记可选文件与步骤。output_length_tokens 可提供原始估计，省略时由工具估计。contract 只读；gate 接受后写出独立缩减计划，--accept 跳过交互检查。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
node dist/src/index.js contract examples/plan.json
node dist/src/index.js contract examples/plan.json --json
node dist/src/index.js gate examples/plan.json
